scenarios.title: End one runaway session
scenarios.setup:
psql -q -c "CREATE DATABASE shop"
psql -q -d shop -c "CREATE TABLE orders (id int PRIMARY KEY, total numeric(10,2) NOT NULL);
                    INSERT INTO orders SELECT g, g * 10 FROM generate_series(1, 5) g;"
# Two long-running client sessions: report-job and billing. Each runs two long statements from a file, so
# cancelling the first statement does not end the session.
printf 'SELECT pg_sleep(300);\nSELECT pg_sleep(300);\n' > "$LAB/long.sql"
for name in report-job billing; do
    PGAPPNAME=$name nohup psql -q -d shop -f "$LAB/long.sql" > /dev/null 2>&1 &
done
for i in $(seq 1 100); do
    [ "$(psql -Atc "SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE application_name IN ('report-job', 'billing')")" = 2 ] && break
    sleep 0.1
done

scenarios.title: End the root blocker
scenarios.setup:
psql -q -c "CREATE DATABASE shop" -c "CREATE ROLE app LOGIN" -c "CREATE ROLE report LOGIN"
psql -q -d shop -c "CREATE TABLE orders (id int PRIMARY KEY, status text NOT NULL);
                    INSERT INTO orders SELECT g, 'new' FROM generate_series(1, 5) g;
                    GRANT SELECT, UPDATE ON orders TO app, report;"
# client NAME SQL: a session named NAME runs SQL, then stays connected without sending anything more.
client() { (printf '%s\n' "$2"; sleep 600) | PGAPPNAME=$1 nohup psql -q -d shop > /dev/null 2>&1 & }
# waiting N: wait until N sessions are waiting for a lock.
waiting() {
    for i in $(seq 1 100); do
        [ "$(psql -Atc "SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE wait_event_type = 'Lock'")" = "$1" ] && return
        sleep 0.1
    done
}
client batch-import "BEGIN; UPDATE orders SET status = 'importing' WHERE id = 1;"
client reporting "BEGIN; SELECT count(*) FROM orders;"
sleep 0.5
client checkout "UPDATE orders SET status = 'paid' WHERE id = 1;"
sleep 0.3
waiting 1

scenarios.title: Drop the slot of a dead replica
scenarios.setup:
psql -q -c "CREATE SCHEMA shop" -c "CREATE TABLE shop.orders (id int PRIMARY KEY, total numeric(10,2) NOT NULL)" \
     -c "INSERT INTO shop.orders SELECT g, g * 10 FROM generate_series(1, 5) g"
pg_basebackup -D "$LAB/replica" -R -C -S replica_a -c fast -d "application_name=replica_a"
echo "port = 5433" >> "$LAB/replica/postgresql.auto.conf"
pg_ctl start -D "$LAB/replica" -w -l "$LAB/replica.log" > /dev/null
until [ "$(psql -Atc "SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_replication WHERE application_name = 'replica_a'
                      AND state = 'streaming' AND flush_lsn >= pg_current_wal_lsn()")" = 1 ]; do sleep 0.2; done
psql -qAtc "SELECT pg_create_physical_replication_slot('replica_b', true)" > /dev/null
# Some traffic while the dead replica's slot keeps its WAL
for i in 1 2 3; do
    psql -qc "INSERT INTO shop.orders SELECT g, 1 FROM generate_series(1000 * $i, 1000 * $i + 99) g"
    psql -qAtc "SELECT pg_switch_wal()" > /dev/null
done
psql -qc "CHECKPOINT"
